The money is in sight, so why is the hill so hard?

Kevin Trudeau describes a hill with riches at the top. You walk up, you get tired, you start sliding back, and you can't work out why.

What you don't realize, he says, is that a thousand pounds of rocks is strapped to your back. He calls that a counter intention: a hidden resistance working against what you want.

Until it is cleared, Kevin says, you can't manifest or achieve what you want.

When did you last feel something invisible holding you back?

#ad #mindset #success #goals

What if your ancestors taught you that money isn't safe?

Kevin Trudeau says someone in your family line may have had money stolen, lost friends over it, or been scammed. After that, they decided money is bad.

Others believed they were born on the wrong side of the tracks and didn't deserve it. Kevin says those beliefs can sit inside you without your knowing.

That is especially true, he says, if your family never had much wealth or success.

What did your family teach you about money?

#ad #money #mindset #wealth

You want love, so why do you keep pushing it away?

Kevin Trudeau gives an example. Early in life someone comes home and finds their partner with somebody else. In that moment of pain, they decide never to trust again.

They forget it, but years later they are jealous in every relationship and suspect everyone. Kevin says a hidden counter intention is steering them, and they sabotage the good relationship.

Have you ever wondered why the same pattern keeps repeating in love?

#ad #love #relationships #mindset

What changed when Kevin stopped fearing a room full of people?

Kevin Trudeau says he stuttered, was incredibly shy, and his face turned bright red around others. He says his biggest block was communication.

He says that after clearing the counter intentions in his DNA and memories, he became a good communicator. People get his point, and they get the intention behind his words.

What would change if you felt completely sure of yourself around people?

#ad #confidence #mindset #success

Remember when you said you'd be an astronaut?

Kevin Trudeau points out what many of us heard as kids: "Stop dreaming. What makes you think you can do that? You'll just be disappointed. Be realistic."

He says the ability to think big is critical to success and happiness in every area of life. And it is exactly the ability that gets hit with a heavy counter intention.

Who told you to stop dreaming, and did you listen?

#ad #goals #success #happiness

Imagine a path with nothing pushing back.

Kevin Trudeau calls a counter intention invisible resistance. When it is cleared, he says, you have no more resistance and no self-sabotage kicking in.

You are free to choose what you really want and go after it. The doors are open, and all you have to do is walk.

He is clear that you still have to take the steps. You just stop having anything going against you.

What would you start tomorrow if nothing held you back?

#ad #goals #mindset #freedom

What does it feel like when nothing is holding you back?

Kevin Trudeau says you feel lighter. You feel a sense of expansion, powerful, optimistic and in control.

He says your confidence in reaching your goals skyrockets, because you know you won't meet invisible resistance as you move toward what you want.

When did you last feel completely sure of yourself?

#ad #confidence #mindset #goals
